scripts.docker:start: mkdir -p ./data/mysql && mkdir -p ./data/logs && mkdir -p ./data/minodu-backend && chmod 755 ./data/minodu-backend && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.docker:clean: docker compose down -v --remove-orphans --rmi all && docker volume prune -f && docker network prune -f
scripts.sync: rm -f ./tools/sync/download.zip && npm run sync:update_backup && npm run sync:database && npm run sync:rag
scripts.sync:database: npx dotenv -- sh -c 'poetry --directory tools/sync run python sync_database.py http://137.184.46.216:3000/files/minodu_backend_backup.zip --destination=../../data/minodu-backend --user=$MYSQL_USER --password=$MYSQL_PASSWORD'
scripts.sync:rag: poetry --directory tools/sync run python sync_rag.py http://localhost/api/backend/v1/posts/ minodu-minodu-ai-services-1
